title: Zambales town adopts 4-day workweek amid extreme heat, fuel price hike

blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO, Zambales — The municipal government of Candelaria, Zambales will implement a four-day workweek and a temporary work-from-home (WFH) arrangement for government personnel beginning on October 19 to address “the prevailing extreme heat and rising fuel prices,” Mayor Byron Jones E. Edquilang said in a memorandum. Under the new arrangement, municipal employees will work from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. from Monday to Thursday. Friday, Oct. 16, will be observed as a WFH day for personnel covered by the arrangement. Employees providing essential frontline services, public safety, emergency response, sanitation, maintenance and field operations are exempted and must continue reporting […]...
